title: AI-assessed sarcopenia as an independent predictor of neoadjuvant chemotherapy outcomes in muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
summary: The primary source Methods/Results confirm the represented result: Retrospective single-centre study where AI-powered CT sarcopenia (skeletal muscle index) software predicts neoadjuvant chemotherapy response in muscle-invasive bladder cancer; a clinically specific retrospective assessment. The result is reported in the La radiologia medica. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
